headline: RU administration to file case over attack on journalists and students
summary: Journalists called off a protest after assurances that legal action would be taken against the perpetrators of the Sunday night attack on campus.
details: The Rajshahi University (RU) administration has announced it will file a legal case following an attack on journalists and students on its campus.
Journalists assigned to the university had launched a protest, which they called off around midnight on Sunday after receiving assurances that the case would be filed by Monday.

Despite calling off the protest, journalists remain firm on several demands, including the immediate arrest and expulsion of the perpetrators, as well as the resignation of relevant administration officials.
RU Pro-Vice Chancellor (Academic) Prof Mamunur Rashid condemned the attack, describing it as 'highly deplorable.'
Prof Rashid stated that the case would be filed on Monday at the initiative of the hall administration, and other demands would be processed according to due process.
Additionally, the Chhatra Dal central committee has formed two separate investigation committees to probe the incident.

headline: Rain forecast for capital: Rain and thunderstorms likely in Dhaka
summary: The Meteorological Department predicts a drop in temperature and partial cloudiness for the capital and surrounding areas.
details: The Meteorological Department has issued a forecast for Dhaka and its surrounding areas, predicting rain or thunderstorms today, Monday, October 5.
According to the six-hour forecast issued at 1:00 PM, the sky will remain partially to temporarily cloudy with a possibility of rain or thunderstorms.
Winds will flow from the south and southwest at a 10 to 15 kmph speed. Daytime temperatures are expected to decrease slightly.
As of 12:00 PM today, the temperature in Dhaka was 32.2 degrees Celsius with 59% humidity. Yesterday's maximum temperature was 35.5 degrees Celsius, while today's minimum is 27.5 degrees Celsius.
The sun will set at 5:42 PM today and rise tomorrow morning at 5:52 AM.
Additionally, the Meteorological Department stated that there are no warnings or signals for the country's internal river ports from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM today.
